description: Search and inspect public peptide certificates of analysis using the PeptidePrices evidence library and supported laboratory records. Look up exact report identifiers or public certificate URLs, review vendor and compound matches, inspect reported testing panels, browse a vendor’s published certificate feed, or compare documented COA coverage across vendors. Results keep laboratory-record confirmation, vendor attribution, product and labeled-strength matching, reported analytical results, and physical-vial chain of custody separate. Missing, blocked, unsupported, or unresolved records remain unknown rather than being treated as failures. Each result includes structured evidence and links to PeptidePrices, certificate documents, and specific official laboratory records when available.
